headline: Frontlines Surge as Bases Flip Across Multiple Sectors
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the heaviest sectors have continued to churn. Weathered Expanse remains the most volatile, logging fifty‑one base transitions in the past day and a fresh flip in the last two hours as Colonial and Warden losses climb to eighty‑two and fifty‑five per hour respectively. Godcrofts has sustained its rapid turnover with three captures in six hours, while Mooring County added two more changes though its casualty surge has begun to ease. Nevish Line still leads in total transitions at fifty‑six, yet no new flips appeared in the latest windows even as Warden casualties accelerate to nearly three hundred per hour over the two‑hour comparison. Linn Mercy has surged, recording five ownership shifts in the past two hours and a further five in six, with both sides’ loss rates rising sharply. Kuura Strand and Marban Hollow each show modest but accelerating activity, the former with a recent neutralisation and the latter with eight day‑long changes but none lately. Farranac Coast and Stlican Shelf have tapered, while Callahans Passage and Dead Lands continue to bleed heavily without base movement. Enlistment spikes persist in the most contested zones, suggesting the current flare‑ups may sustain through the next day.
